name: Anise Sawatari Errand Girl Adventure
source:
The player is in control of the character Anise Sawatari as she is made to run errands for her master Chizuko Yamada, inadvertently causing trouble wherever she goes.

[Edited from [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Anise_Sawatari%27s_Errand_Girl_Adventure]AliceSoftWiki[/url]]

An unofficial visual novel based on the non-canonical parody gamebook Anise Sawatari no Otsukai Adventure.
translation:
玩家控制角色泽渡茴香，为主人山田千津子跑腿，无论走到哪里都会无意中造成麻烦。

[编辑自[url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Anise_Sawatari%27s_Errand_Girl_Adventure]AliceSoftWiki[/url]]

改编自非正统模仿游戏书《泽渡茴香大冒险》的非官方视觉小说。
